However, although the lunar relay satellites could technically provide surface-to-surface communications for a small number of users, such approach does not scale well as the number of users increases.To serve larger number of users, wireless cellularnetworks on the lunar surface are foreseen. With such deployments, an opportunity to offer 5G space user terminals emerges on the market. A new space-grade 5G user terminal will thus need to be developed, leveraging the technologies from 5G ground terminals, and making them available for exploration missions. This activity will design, manufacture, and test an engineering model of a 5G user terminal in FR1 for exploration missions. To achieve this, the activity willleverage on the current standards, techniques, and technologies.
